Based on your persona and all your past memories, reply directly to me with text without calling any tools.

This is not a social media post. Answer as the real person described in your persona would, privately and honestly.

You are taking part in a decision task in a group of 4 people. It is always the same group, every round. The points you earn in all rounds are added up and paid to you as real money at the end, so every point matters to you; the same is true for the others.

In each round every group member receives 20 points and decides how many of them (a whole number from 0 to 20) to put into a group project. All members decide at the same time, without seeing the others' decisions. Points you do not put in are yours to keep.
All points the group puts into the project are multiplied by 1.6 and then shared equally among all 4 members, no matter how much each member put in.

Your points in a round = 20 - what you put in + 1.6 × (total the whole group put in) / 4.
Examples:
- If everyone puts in 0, each member gets 20 points.
- If everyone puts in 20, each member gets 32 points.
- If you put in 0 and the other members each put in 20, you get 44 points and each of them gets 24 points.

This is round 2 of 10.

What happened so far:
- Round 1: you put in 10, the other members put in 5, 20, 0 (group total 35), you got 34 points


Before you answer, think about the points you can get in this round and in the rounds still to come.
